name: Olivia Ferro

education.notes: Graduated May 2022. Studied nutrition with business and health-sciences breadth.

keyDecisions: Took a Creative Director role at a digital-health company right out of USC — design + brand reps inside a real healthtech operator.
lessons: A creative/brand seat inside an operating digital-health company is a faster pre-founder track than a generic marketing CV.
Working inside a digital-health company before founding a digital-health company is the cheapest customer-discovery you can do.

keyDecisions: Co-founded SheMed in April 2024 with her sister Chloe Ferro — sibling team built on a shared digital-health background.
Took CEO seat alongside Chloe as President — clean role split between operators with overlapping but distinct skill stacks.
Scaled from launch to $1B valuation in ~18 months — among the fastest UK healthtech unicorn trajectories on record.
lessons: Sibling co-founder pair is a high-trust structure that compresses early decision-making cycles.
Healthtech unicorn velocity is achievable in the UK when the buyer is direct consumer (not the NHS) and willingness-to-pay is regulatory-tailwind (GLP-1 demand).
Found at 24, two years post-degree, with one operator role in the right vertical — the 'short ramp' template.
careerSteps.notes: SheMed founded April 2024. $50M Series A October 2025 → $1B unicorn valuation. Olivia is CEO; sister Chloe is President. Forbes 30 Under 30 Europe 2026 (Science & Healthcare).

outcomes.currentStatus: Co-Founder & CEO of SheMed (London); $1B unicorn after $50M Series A in October 2025. Pre-exit; paper wealth.

lessons.lesson: Two-year ramp from graduating university to founding a unicorn is achievable when the prior operator job is inside the exact vertical.
lessons.source: Inferred from USC → eMed → SheMed arc.

lessons.lesson: Sibling co-founder pair compresses trust-building and aligns founder incentives without contract gymnastics.
Consumer-healthtech wedge with a regulatory tailwind (GLP-1) beats horizontal consumer health for early capture.
